summary: Pulse Biosciences filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing interim six-month results from its PRECISE-BTN clinical study of the nPulse Vybrance Percutaneous Electrode System for symptomatic benign thyroid nodules. Data covered 43 patients across three U.S. sites: 86% met the primary endpoint of at least 50% nodule volume reduction, median reduction was 72%, ThyPRO-39 quality-of-life impact improved 78%, and no serious adverse events were reported. This is a routine clinical-results current report with a press release exhibit, not a special situation; no deal terms, valuation, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed.
